targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', date(criada_em)) AS INTEGER) AS time, count(*) AS investigacoes FROM investigacoes WHERE criada_em >= datetime('now', '-30 days') GROUP BY date(criada_em) ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', date(criada_em)) AS INTEGER) AS time, count(*) AS investigacoes FROM investigacoes WHERE criada_em >= datetime('now', '-30 days') GROUP BY date(criada_em) ORDER BY time

targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', date(quando)) AS INTEGER) AS time, sum(tipo = 'login') AS certos, sum(tipo IN ('login_falhou', 'login_bloqueado')) AS errados FROM eventos WHERE quando >= datetime('now', '-30 days') AND tipo IN ('login', 'login_falhou', 'login_bloqueado') GROUP BY date(quando) ORDER BY time
